criteria.statement: Under EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=local, each candidate's score is the normalised linear blend (alpha*cosine_norm + (1-alpha)*lexical_norm) with the exact-rule-id/parent-rule-id boost merged into the blended score
alpha is a single named constant in [0.50, 0.70]; the chosen value and the full sweep are recorded in REQ-182's Notes
The blend is scored over the full candidate list, never a truncated top-N of either ranking
Under mock, and on any embedding failure, scoring is byte-identical to the prior lexical-only path (benchmark clean recall@5 0.5833/MRR 0.4249, polluted 0.5256/0.3872)
All 12 labelled fixture checks pass under the semantic path (system3-expected-recall, system3-noise-excluded across the eight labelled fixtures)
Benchmark clean recall@5 is at or above 0.8526 and polluted recall@5 at or above 0.8333
Clean/polluted MRR are recorded in REQ-182's Notes alongside recall, reported rather than gated
System 3 stays capped at 5 excerpts, still deduplicated against the System 2 selection by rule-number prefix, prompt section placement unchanged
scripts/rag-retrieval-benchmark.mjs --semantic (via scoreBenchmarkSemantic) fails loudly rather than silently reporting a lexical result as semantic when the embedder is unavailable

The six documentation blocks (REQ-182 new, REQ-177/REQ-181/REQ-022 amendments, system-map.md, system-map/game-rules-retrieval.md, in-depth/README.md, system-map/prompt-layout-spec.md) are applied by intent, matching the finalized GATE-QUESTIONS.md diff
